## DayZ Server Manager v1.0.5

Cleaner **`logs/manager.log`** on busy hosts (RCON player polling, ModSync key copies).

### Download

**`dayz_manager-v1.0.5-windows-x64.zip`**

### Highlights

- No DEBUG line on every RCON `players` request (two servers ≈ 24 lines/min removed).
- Windows bercon output decoded as cp866 for correct BattlEye tables.
- ModSync logs one summary line per mod when copying `.bikey` files.

### Upgrading from v1.0.4

Replace `DayZManager.exe` and `web\`. Keep `config\` and `data\`.
